l3MappingPoints.note: Difference between supply air temperature and mixed air temperature on units with Direct Fire Heat.

l3MappingPoints.name: Calculated Heat Rise
l3MappingPoints.note: The heat rise limit determined by how open the Outside Damper is.

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Air Relative Humidity
l3MappingPoints.note: If an EBUS Supply Air Sensor is being used this shows the current supply air relative humidity reading.

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Air Dew Point
l3MappingPoints.note: If an EBUS Supply Air Sensor is being used this shows the current calculated supply air dew point.

l3MappingPoints.name: Space Dew Point
l3MappingPoints.note: Current value of the calculated Space Dew Point.

l3MappingPoints.name: Return Dew Point
l3MappingPoints.note: Current value of the calculated Return Dew Point.

l3MappingPoints.name: Occupied Cooling Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: If the control temperature rises one deadband above this setpoint, the control activates the cooling demand. This setpoint does not determine the mode in Occupied operation if the unit is configured for Supply Air Cooling or Supply Air Temp

l3MappingPoints.name: Occupied Heating Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: If the control temperature drops one deadband below this setpoint, the control activates the heating demand. This setpoint does not determine the mode in Occupied operation if the unit is configured for Supply Air Cooling or Supply Air Temp

l3MappingPoints.name: Hood On Cooling Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: This is the Cooling Mode Enable Setpoint used only in Hood On Mode or Space Temperature Control of High Percentage Outdoor Air Units or VAV Tempering

l3MappingPoints.name: Hood On Heating Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: This is the Heating Mode Enable Setpoint used only in Hood On Mode or Space Temperature Control of High Percentage Outdoor Air Units or VAV Tempering

l3MappingPoints.name: Unoccupied Cooling Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: During the Unoccupied Mode of Operation, this Setpoint offsets the Occupied Cooling Setpoint up by this user- adjustable amount. Use the default setting of 30°F for this setpoint to prevent Cooling during the Unoccupied Mode.

l3MappingPoints.name: Unoccupied Heating Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: During the Unoccupied Mode of Operation, this Setpoint offsets the Occupied Heating Setpoint down by this user- adjustable amount. Use the default setting of 30°F for this setpoint to prevent Heating during Unoccupied Mode.

l3MappingPoints.name: Mode Select Deadband
l3MappingPoints.note: This value is added to and subtracted from the HVAC Mode Setpoints to create a control deadband range

l3MappingPoints.name: Max Coil Setpoint Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: This is the highest that the Coil Temperature resets to during Space Humidity Reset of the Coil Suction Temperature Setpoint. If no coil temperature reset is required, this value should be set the same as the Min Coil Reset Limit.

l3MappingPoints.name: Min Coil Setpoint Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: This is the lowest the Coil Temperature resets to during Space Humidity Reset of the Coil Suction Temperature Setpoint. If no coil temperature reset is required, this value should be set the same as the Max Coil Reset Limit.

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Air Cooling Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: Supply Air Cooling Setpoint. If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the Low SAT Cooling Reset Value

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Air Heating Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: Supply Air Heating Setpoint. If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the Low SAT Heating Reset Value

l3MappingPoints.name: Max SAT Cooling Setpoint Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the High SAT Cooling Reset Value

l3MappingPoints.name: Max SAT Heating Setpoint Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the High SAT Heating Reset Value

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Air Cooling Staging Window
l3MappingPoints.note: In Cooling Mode, if the Supply Air Temperature drops below the Active Supply Air Cooling Setpoint minus this Staging Window, the Cooling Stage deactivates after its Minimum Run Time
l3MappingPoints.tierDescription: L2 템플릿 후보 — BMS 기본 화면에 먼저 올릴 포인트

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Air Heating Staging Window
l3MappingPoints.note: In Heating Mode, if the Supply Air Temperature rises above the Active Supply Air Heating Setpoint plus this Staging Window, the Heating Stage deactivates after its Minimum Run Time

l3MappingPoints.name: Warm-Up Target Temperature (See AV: 89 for Cool-Down Target Temperature)
l3MappingPoints.note: If Morning Warm-Up is configured, then upon entering occupied mode, the Warm-Up Mode activates if the Return Air is below this temperature by one degree

l3MappingPoints.name: Warm-Up Mode Supply Air Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: During Morning Warm-Up, the Supply Air Temperature is controlled to this Setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: Cool-Down Mode Supply Air Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: During Morning Cool-Down, the Supply Air Temperature is controlled to this Setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: Mechanical Cooling Outdoor Air Lockout
l3MappingPoints.note: Mechanical Cooling is locked out when the Outdoor Air Temperature is below this Setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: Mechanical Heating Outdoor Air Lockout
l3MappingPoints.note: Mechanical Heating is locked out when the Outdoor Air Temperature is above this Setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: Low Supply Temp Cutoff Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Cooling is disabled if the Supply Air Temperature falls below this value. See sequence for more details
l3MappingPoints.tierDescription: L2 템플릿 후보 — BMS 기본 화면에 먼저 올릴 포인트

l3MappingPoints.name: High Supply Temp Cutoff Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Heating is disabled if the Supply Air Temperature rises above this value. See sequence for more details

l3MappingPoints.name: Preheater Cooling Mode Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Cooling Mode, this is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature

l3MappingPoints.name: Preheater Venting Mode Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Vent Mode, this setpoint is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature

l3MappingPoints.name: Preheater Heating Mode Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Heating Mode, this setpoint is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature

l3MappingPoints.name: Outdoor Air Dewpoint Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: On an MUA unit, if the OA dewpoint rises above this setpoint, Dehumidification is initiated

l3MappingPoints.name: Economizer Enable Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: The economizer is enabled if the outdoor drybulb, dewpoint, or wetbulb temperature falls below this setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: Heat Wheel Defrost Enable Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: The unit goes into Heat Wheel Defrost if the Outdoor Air is below this setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: PreHeat Enable Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Supply Fan is energized, this is the temperature at which the Preheat Relay activates, or the Preheat-X activates. Operates only in the Occupied Mode.

l3MappingPoints.name: Sensor Slide Offset Max Effect
l3MappingPoints.note: If the space sensor has the optional slide adjustment feature, this is the maximum amount the slide can adjust the current heating and cooling setpoints up or down with full deflection of the slide

l3MappingPoints.name: Space Sensor Calibration Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Space Temperature Sensor is reading incorrectly, use this option to enter an offset temperature to adjust the Sensor’s Temperature

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Air Sensor Calibration Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Supply Air Temperature Sensor is reading incorrectly, use this option to enter an offset temperature to adjust the Sensor’s Temperature

l3MappingPoints.name: Return Air Sensor Calibration Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Return Temperature Sensor is reading incorrectly, use this option to enter an offset temperature to adjust the Sensor’s Temperature

l3MappingPoints.name: Outdoor Air Sensor Calibration Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Outdoor Temperature Sensor is reading incorrectly, use this option to enter an offset temperature to adjust the Sensor’s Temperature

l3MappingPoints.name: Carbon Dioxide Sensor Calibration Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: If the CO2 Sensor is reading incorrectly, use this option to enter an offset value to adjust the Sensor’s CO2 reading

l3MappingPoints.name: Low Ambient Protection Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: Temperature at which the Low Ambient Relay activates in the Occupied or Unoccupied Mode

l3MappingPoints.name: SAT Cool Setpoint Reset Source Low Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: If doing Supply Air Setpoint Reset, this is the Low Reset Source value in Cooling that corresponds to the Supply Air Cool High Reset Setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: SAT Cool Setpoint Reset Source High Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: If doing Supply Air Setpoint Reset, this is the High Reset Source value in Cooling that corresponds to the Supply Air Cooling Setpoint (Low Reset)

l3MappingPoints.name: SAT Heat Setpoint Reset Source Low Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: If doing Supply Air Setpoint Reset, this is the Low Reset Source value in Heating that corresponds to the Supply Air Heating High Reset Setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: SAT Heat Setpoint Reset Source High Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: If doing Supply Air Setpoint Reset, this is the High Reset Source value in Heating that corresponds to the Supply Air Heating Setpoint (Low Reset)

l3MappingPoints.name: Control Temperature High Alarm Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: If the temperature of the controlling sensor rises above the Occupied Cooling Setpoint by this value, a High Control Temp Alarm occurs. Only applies if configured for Space or Return Air Temp Control, or as Single Zone VAV.

l3MappingPoints.name: Control Temperature Low Alarm Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: If the temperature of the controlling sensor falls below the Occupied Heating Setpoint by this value, a Low Control Temp Alarm occurs. Only applies if configured for Space or Return Air Temp Control, or as Single Zone VAV.

l3MappingPoints.name: Heat Pump Compressor Heat Lockout
l3MappingPoints.note: Compressor Heat is locked out below this setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: Maximum Main Fan VFD in SZ VAV Heating Mode
l3MappingPoints.note: In Single Zone VAV configuration, this is the max fan speed the VFD can modulate up to in Heat Mode

l3MappingPoints.name: Minimum Main Fan VFD in Cooling Mode
l3MappingPoints.note: In Single Zone VAV configuration, this is the fan speed at which the VFD starts when Cooling is initiated. In a VAV configuration this is the lowest fan speed allowed in the Cooling Mode. In CAV and MUA configurations this should be set to

l3MappingPoints.name: Minimum Main Fan VFD in Heating Mode
l3MappingPoints.note: In Single Zone VAV configuration, this is the fan speed at which the VFD starts when Heating is initiated. In a VAV configuration this is the lowest fan speed allowed in the Heating Mode. In CAV and MUA configurations this should be set to

l3MappingPoints.name: Minimum Main Fan VFD in Vent Mode
l3MappingPoints.note: Speed at which the VFD operates in the Vent Mode in Single Zone VAV

l3MappingPoints.name: Maximum Economizer in Heating Mode
l3MappingPoints.note: Max position the Economizer Damper opens to in Supply Air Tempering during Heating Mode. Takes priority over Max Position in High CO2.
l3MappingPoints.tierDescription: L2 템플릿 후보 — BMS 기본 화면에 먼저 올릴 포인트

l3MappingPoints.name: Minimum Economizer Position
l3MappingPoints.note: The minimum position of the Outdoor Air damper in the Occupied Mode. This can be reset upwards based on indoor CO2 levels. NOTE: See Economizer Override via BACnet section in the Economizer area of the Sequence of Operations for additional
l3MappingPoints.tierDescription: L2 템플릿 후보 — BMS 기본 화면에 먼저 올릴 포인트

l3MappingPoints.name: Maximum Economizer CO2 Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: The maximum value the Economizer Minimum Position can be reset up to during CO2 override

l3MappingPoints.name: Minimum Carbon Dioxide Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: This is the threshold CO2 level at which the Economizer Min Damper Position Setpoint begins to be reset higher

l3MappingPoints.name: Maximum Carbon Dioxide Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: This is the CO2 level at which the Economizer Min Damper Position resets to the Economizer Max Position in High CO2. In between the Min and Max CO2 levels the Economizer Min Damper Position is proportionally reset between the configured Min

l3MappingPoints.name: Indoor Humidity Setpoint Low Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: On indoor controlled (non-MUA) units, this is the Humidity setpoint at which the unit leaves Dehumidification. During Coil Temp Reset, this is the lowest Space RH value that corresponds to the High Coil Temp Setpoint. If the VCCX2 is config

l3MappingPoints.name: Indoor Humidity Setpoint High Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: On indoor controlled (non-MUA) units, this is the Humidity setpoint at which the unit initiates Dehumidification. During Coil Temp Reset, this is the highest Space RH value that corresponds to the Low Coil Temp Setpoint. If the VCCX2 is con

l3MappingPoints.name: Duct Static Pressure Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.tierDescription: L2 템플릿 후보 — BMS 기본 화면에 먼저 올릴 포인트

l3MappingPoints.name: Duct Static Pressure Control Deadband
l3MappingPoints.note: Value above and below the Duct Static Pressure Setpoint where no control change occurs

l3MappingPoints.name: Building Pressure Control Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: Building Pressure Setpoint or Exhaust Duct Static Pressure Setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: Building Pressure Control Deadband
l3MappingPoints.note: Value above and below the Building Pressure Setpoint or the Exhaust Duct Static Pressure Setpoint where no control change occurs

l3MappingPoints.name: Outdoor CFM Control Deadband
l3MappingPoints.note: Controls rate of change for damper signal. As OA CFM moves further from setpoint within this window, the damper makes a larger change.

l3MappingPoints.name: Single Zone VAV Fan Speed Integral
l3MappingPoints.note: The Integral Constant for Single Zone VAV Fan Control

l3MappingPoints.name: Relay Run-time Hours Warning Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: If any configured relay’s run time exceeds this number of hours of operation, a warning alarm is generated so that periodic maintenance can be performed

l3MappingPoints.name: Cooling Mode Head Pressure Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: Head Pressure Setpoint in the Cooling Mode

l3MappingPoints.name: Dehum Mode Head Pressure Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: Head Pressure Setpoint in the Dehumidification Mode

l3MappingPoints.name: Maximum Outdoor CFM Requirement
l3MappingPoints.note: Maximum Outdoor Airflow CFM Setpoint in High CO2

l3MappingPoints.name: Schedule Force
l3MappingPoints.note: 0 = Auto (uses controller’s schedule) 1 = Forced Occupied 2 = Forced Unoccupied

l3MappingPoints.name: HVAC Mode Override
l3MappingPoints.note: Overrides normal controller operation to force the unit into this desired mode. Configuring for “Auto” restores normal unit control of the mode of operation. 0=Auto 1=Vent 2=Cool 3=Heat 4=Vent Dehum 5=Cool Dehum 6=Heat Dehum.

l3MappingPoints.name: Fan VFD Override
l3MappingPoints.note: Override to force the VFD to this percentage speed. Configuring “Auto” restores normal unit control of the VFD speed.

l3MappingPoints.name: Outdoor Air Damper Override
l3MappingPoints.note: Overrides all other Outdoor Air Damper position commands to maintain this fixed position. Configuring for “Auto” restores normal unit control of the Outdoor Air Damper/ Economizer operation. NOTE: When a value of 0 or 100% is written the co

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Setpoint Override
l3MappingPoints.note: This overrides whatever setpoint the Supply Air Temperature is currently being controlled to. 0=No Override.

l3MappingPoints.name: Space Temperature Value
l3MappingPoints.note: If the controller is configured for this operation, the user can write a Space Sensor value

l3MappingPoints.name: Space Humidity Value
l3MappingPoints.note: If the controller is configured for this operation, the user can write a Space Humidity Sensor value

l3MappingPoints.name: Indoor RH Calibration Offset
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Space Humidity Sensor is reading incorrectly, use this option to enter an offset humidity to adjust the Sensor’s Humidity

l3MappingPoints.name: Relief Fan VFD
l3MappingPoints.note: Override to force the VFD to this percentage speed. Configuring “Auto” restores normal unit control of the VFD speed

l3MappingPoints.name: Relief Pressure Value
l3MappingPoints.note: If the controller is configured for this operation, the user can write Building Pressure Sensor value

l3MappingPoints.name: Carbon Dioxide Value
l3MappingPoints.note: If the controller is configured for this operation, the user can write a CO2 Sensor value.

l3MappingPoints.name: Outdoor Air Temperature Value
l3MappingPoints.note: If the controller is configured for this operation, the user can write an Outdoor Sensor value

l3MappingPoints.name: Outdoor Air Humidity Value
l3MappingPoints.note: If the controller is configured for this operation, the user can write an Outdoor Humidity Sensor value

l3MappingPoints.name: Max Plenum Pressure Setpoint Reset Limit
Min Plenum Pressure Setpoint Reset Limit
Enthalpy Enable Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: If configured for Comparative Enthalpy Economizer Control, the OA Enthalpy must be below this setpoint by the Enthalpy Enable Deadband before the OA/RA Enthalpy comparison is utilized to enable the Economizer

l3MappingPoints.name: EnthalpyEnable Deadband
l3MappingPoints.note: The OA Enthalpy must be below the Enthalpy Enable Setpoint by this amount, and the OA Enthalpy must be below the RA Enthalpy by this amount to utilize the Economizer

l3MappingPoints.name: Maximum Static Setpoint Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: As the most open VAV damper rises above 80%, the static setpoint resets up to this maximum limit

l3MappingPoints.name: Minimum Static Setpoint Reset Limit
l3MappingPoints.note: As the most open VAV damper drops below 80%, the static setpoint resets down to this minimum reset limit

l3MappingPoints.name: Static Setpoint Reset Interval
l3MappingPoints.note: The Reset Interval is how often the setpoint reset calculation occurs. This must be an infrequent event, so the default is 15 minutes.

l3MappingPoints.name: Cool-Down Target Temperature (See AV: 16 for Warm-Up Target Temperature)
l3MappingPoints.note: If Morning Cool-Down is configured then upon entering occupied mode, the Cool-Down Mode activates if the return air is above this temperature by one degree

l3MappingPoints.name: Warm-Up Override
l3MappingPoints.note: Commands the unit into Morning Warm-Up Mode. 1=Command Warm-Up Mode

l3MappingPoints.name: Cool Down Override
l3MappingPoints.note: Commands the unit into Morning Cool-Down Mode 1=Command Cool-Down Mode

l3MappingPoints.name: Return Air High Limit Protection (for Voting Units or CV Units Only)
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Return Air Temperature goes above this limit, the unit reverts to Return Air Control. NOTE: This point only applies when the BMS is writing a space temperature value to the VCCX2 and that value is lost.

l3MappingPoints.name: Return Air Low Limit Protection (for Voting Units or CV Units Only)
l3MappingPoints.note: If the Return Air Temperature goes below this limit, the unit reverts to Return Air Control. NOTE: This point only applies when the BMS is writing a space temperature value to the VCCX2 and that value is lost.

l3MappingPoints.name: Sump Drain Override
l3MappingPoints.note: Setting this value to 1 turns the Sump Drain relay on. Setting this value to 0 sets the relay operation to Auto. 0=Auto 1=On

l3MappingPoints.name: Return Plenum Pressure Deadband
l3MappingPoints.note: Value above and below the Return Plenum Pressure Setpoint where no control change occurs

l3MappingPoints.name: Dehum Lockout Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: If Outdoor Air temperature is below this setpoint, Dehumidification Mode is locked out

l3MappingPoints.name: Emergency Compressor Lockout
l3MappingPoints.note: This point can be used to lockout the compressors if the BMS wants them disabled.

l3MappingPoints.name: Supply Air Dew Point Setpoint
l3MappingPoints.note: When the VCCX2 is configured for DX-DOAS control it modulates the compressors to try to maintain the Supply Air Dew Point Setpoint during dehumidification mode.

l3MappingPoints.name: Cooling Enabled Status
l3MappingPoints.note: Status that indicates Mechanical Cooling is enabled based on the Cooling Lockout

l3MappingPoints.name: Heating Enabled Status
l3MappingPoints.note: Status that indicates that Mechanical Heating is enabled based on the Heating Lockout

l3MappingPoints.name: Economizer Enabled Status
l3MappingPoints.note: Status that indicates the Economizer is enabled based on the Economizer Enable Setpoint

l3MappingPoints.name: Emergency Heat Enabled Status
l3MappingPoints.note: Shows the Emergency Heat is enabled based on the Compressor Heating Lockout

l3MappingPoints.note: Remote Forced Cooling Mode Binary Input Status

l3MappingPoints.name: Remote Forced Heating Status
l3MappingPoints.note: Remote Forced Heating Mode Binary Input Status

l3MappingPoints.name: Remote Force Dehum Status
l3MappingPoints.note: Remote Force Dehumidification Mode Binary Input Status

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Supply Air Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: Alarm that indicates a failure of the Supply Air Sensor

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Return Air Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: Alarm that indicates a failure of the Return Air Sensor

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Outdoor Air Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: Failure of the Outdoor Air Temperature Sensor

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Space Temp Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: Failure of the Space Temperature Sensor. If Space is the controlling sensor, the unit shuts down.

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Building Pressure Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: Alarm indicating missing or failed Building Pressure Sensor

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Outdoor Airflow Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: An Outdoor Airflow Sensor is configured, but not detected

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Exhaust Airflow Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: An Exhaust Airflow Sensor is configured, but not detected

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Supply Airflow Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: A Supply Airflow Sensor is configured, but not detected

l3MappingPoints.name: Bad Return Airflow Sensor
l3MappingPoints.note: A Return Airflow Sensor is configured, but not detected

l3MappingPoints.name: Mechanical Cooling Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Compressor Relays are enabled but the Supply Air Temperature has not fallen 5°F w/in a user-adjustable time period. This does not apply to Modulating Cooling.

l3MappingPoints.name: Mechanical Heating Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Heating Mode has been initiated but the Supply Air Temperature has not risen 5°F w/in a user-adjustable time period. Alarms on the MODGAS-X and Preheat-X Controller generate this alarm. This alarm does not apply to SCR Heat, Modulating Hot

l3MappingPoints.name: Fan Proving Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Alarm that indicates an Airflow failure from the Main Fan. Heating and Cooling are disabled.

l3MappingPoints.name: High Supply Temp Cutoff

l3MappingPoints.name: Low Supply Temp Cutoff
l3MappingPoints.note: The Supply Air has fallen below the Low SAT Cutoff Setpoint. Cooling stages deactivate. After 10 minutes, the fan deactivates and this alarm is generated.

l3MappingPoints.name: High Control Mode Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Occurs when the Controlling Sensor Temperature rises above the Cooling Mode Enable Setpoint plus the Control Mode High Alarm Offset. Applies only to Space or Return Air Temperature controlled units.

l3MappingPoints.name: Low Control Mode Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Occurs when the Controlling Sensor Temperature falls below the Heating Mode Enable Setpoint minus the Control Mode Low Alarm Offset. Applies only to Space or Return Air Temperature controlled units.

l3MappingPoints.note: Signal on EM1 binary input 2 from Direct Fire Module that indicates that the direct fire heater is active.

l3MappingPoints.name: Direct Fire Alarm Status
l3MappingPoints.note: Signal on EM1 binary input 3 that indicates there is an active alarm on the Direct Fire Module.

l3MappingPoints.name: Temp Rise Warning
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates the heat rise when direct fire heat is active has exceeded the max heat rise by more than 1°F.

l3MappingPoints.name: Temp Rise Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates the heat rise when direct fire heat is active has exceeded the max heat rise by more than 2°F.

l3MappingPoints.name: Temp Rise Lockout
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates three High Temp Rise alarms occurred within a 1-hour span and the unit heat is disabled until the unit is serviced.

l3MappingPoints.name: High CO2 Rise Warning
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates that high return CO2 was detected when running direct fire heat.

l3MappingPoints.name: High CO2 Rise Alarm
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates high return CO2 was detected and direct fire heat has been temporarily shut down for recovery.

l3MappingPoints.name: High CO2 Rise Lockout
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates three CO2 warning alarms occurred within a 1-hour span and direct fire heat is now disabled until the unit is serviced.

l3MappingPoints.name: Ignition Lockout
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates an active alarm on the Direct Fire Module.

l3MappingPoints.name: Direct Fire Status Lockout
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates that Direct Fire Status Signal is not active within 10 minutes of a call to activate the heat. Heat Enable signal is removed and direct fire heating is locked out.

l3MappingPoints.name: Direct Fire Setpoint Override
l3MappingPoints.note: Indicates the max calculated heat rise is limiting the Supply Air Setpoint to a lower value.

Bus Fail Setpoint Modbus communication is not monitored as standard. In the event of a breakdown in communication, the actuator retains the current setpoint. The bus monitoring controls the Modbus communication. If neither the Setpoint (Register1) nor the Override Control (Register 2) is renewed before the Timeout for Bus Watchdog (Register 110; default:120 s), the actuator controls to the Bus Fail position. Triggered bus monitoring is indicated in the Malfunction and Service Information (Register 105).

Communication Watchdog Time until Bus Fail will be detected. If Bus Watchdog = 0 then deactivated. If Bus Fail setpoint (Register 110) different from 0 then Timeout for Bus Watchdog is by default 120s (parameterizable). Not functional --> reserved for future
